summary: Chiron Real Estate Inc. (formerly Global Medical REIT) filed an 8-K on October 5, 2026 reporting the October 1, 2026 closing of its acquisition of The Pinnacle North Bethesda, a senior housing community in North Bethesda, Maryland, for $173.2 million from affiliates of Silverstone Senior Living. The purchase was funded with cash on hand and roughly $171 million of incremental borrowings under the Company's credit facility, executed through its operating partnership. Chiron entered a management agreement with Greystone Communities to operate the asset. An officer, Robert Zeiller, has a minority Silverstone interest, a related-party disclosure. Watch leverage and cap-rate execution.
